channel.title: Start :: Go Kure
channel.description: Go from nothing to a cluster written to disk. Quickstart - Install the module and generate your first manifests Cluster to disk - The complete pipeline in Go: build a cluster, generate the layout, write it to disk Domain Model - The Cluster, Node, Bundle, Application hierarchy the pipeline walks Using Kure as a Library - Import paths, creating resources, generating YAML Next: Deliver with Flux .
